judgment.counterarguments: Reduction, inflation and assimilation remain possible. Anticipation of six hundred in17:7 is plausible, not observed. Reject the edition's exclusion of reduction based on assumed pious scribal motives; physical plausibility does not decide textual priority.
judgment.age_sensitivity: Without modest chronological preference four remains defensible but comparison is closer.
judgment.literary_scope: Disclosed WLC-based eclectic verse with one numeral substitution; four not demonstrated exclusive to short Greek form.

normalization_note: Existing NFD/remove-marks/slash normalization, then separately recorded numeral replacement and terminal-maqqef removal; maqqef immediately before sof pasuq treated as punctuation cleanup, not a missing-word restoration.
